blocks.title: Doley
blocks.subtitle: Aesthetics, color, and hair health in one space.

children.text: Doley is an image consultancy specializing in color, hair health, and character makeup. For Doley's new chapter in Sant Gervasi, we transformed a former takeover hair salon into a wellness, aesthetics, and treatment space aligned with its brand identity—designed to project professionalism and position it as a local benchmark.

images.alt: Interior design detail and atmosphere of Doley salon

children.text: The project translates the studio's offering into a polished, cohesive image that blends wellness and fantasy, building loyalty among an aligned clientele to boost profitability and pave the way for its own product line.

blocks.alt: Overview of Doley salon featuring dusty pink and sand tones

children.text: Doley brings together creative and technical disciplines that coexist naturally: color as a language, character makeup as artistic expression, and hair health as the essential foundation of wellbeing.

The challenge was merging these worlds in a single space, balancing the expressive energy of color and fantasy with the serenity of a spa and hair treatments. We chose a dusty pink—echoing the original logo—that wraps the space from floor to ceiling as a unifying thread, softened by sand tones and natural woods. Dark styling chairs and the precision of brushed steel complete the palette, striking a balance between warmth, character, and sophistication.
In order: Rustic lime-mortar stucco / Light natural oak finish / Dusty pink clay plaster / Brushed steel / Recycled plastic terrazzo-effect countertop by KIMO.

images.alt: Recycled plastic terrazzo-effect countertop by KIMO
Daytime facade of Doley salon in Sant Gervasi
Lightweight minimalist shelving for product display

children.text: Given the strategic role of this product line—focused on respectful hair and scalp care—we chose to reduce display volume and keep visual clutter to a minimum. A curated set of light, minimalist shelves presents products in an orderly, structured way, reinforcing sophistication and spotlighting the treatment experience.

Spatially, we resolved the complex, irregular footprint of the premises by establishing a logical structure and sizing each functional zone proportionally, allowing us to integrate a separate, dedicated space for the hair spa.

images.alt: Interior view of the redesigned Doley layout
Existing condition of the premises prior to renovation

children.text: Operationally, we restructured the interior to improve circulation around the wash basins and add a private treatment station, avoiding the exposure of the original layout. The former wet zone lacked minimum working clearance and kept the color-mixing area separated from the basins, slowing down daily work. One of the biggest challenges was integrating a dedicated hair spa right next to the water supply.

images.alt: Private treatment station with ceiling-track curtain
Wash basins and hair spa zone

children.text: Solving the lack of storage was a top priority. We designed several strategic points: a generously dimensioned wash area, a back room equipped with a desk, washing machine, and stock cabinets, plus storage integrated directly into the salon furniture. The oval reception counter, wardrobe, and auxiliary units maintain order and lighten the visual field. Floor-to-ceiling mirrors multiply the perception of space—a tool that only works in your favor when order is maintained—creating a bright, spacious atmosphere.

images.alt: Custom furniture and integrated storage solutions
Floor-to-ceiling mirrors and oval counter at Doley salon

blocks.alt: Previous interior condition before the renovation

children.text: Located on a quiet street, it was essential for the salon to gain long-range visibility and draw in passersby.
To capture attention at first glance, we removed posters and signage from the shopfront and cleared out the old furniture, adding clean glass decals detailing the services offered.
At night, warm interior lighting creates an inviting atmosphere while highlighting key focal points inside.
